data: What is the name of the selection strategy that reaches the highest BLEU score?

The caption states that the figure shows BLEU vs. vocabulary size for different selection strategies. The question asks for the name of the selection strategy that reaches the highest BLEU score. From the analysis of the figure, the line representing the "Full 100k" strategy appears to reach the highest BLEU score among all the strategies shown. Therefore, the answer is "Full 100k".
